artworks.title: The Boulevards of Paris
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.description: We look across a street at the façade of a five-story building with a pitched roof in this square sepia-toned photograph. Vertical rectangular windows are spaced along the lowest two levels of the building, which appears to be constructed with large rectangular stones. There is a squat, arched window over a dark opening at the bottom center. The façade of the next two stories is smooth. Tall, narrow arched windows line the third story, and the fourth story has smaller rectangular windows with shutters. Columns frame the central bank of windows in the third and fourth stories. Dormers of the fifth level protrude from the low pitched roof, which nearly reaches the top edge of the photograph. Another house is visible through a narrow alleyway to our right, and another shorter house is cropped by the right edge. Some details of the three horse-drawn carriages lining the street in front of the houses are blurry. The image is surrounded by a wide black band with uneven edges.

artworks.title: Erard de la Marck
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 34 x 24.5 cm (13 3/8 x 9 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a man's head and shoulders. He faces forward with a serious expression, showcasing prominent facial features like a strong brow, pronounced cheekbones, and deep-set eyes. He has short hair. The man wears a hat, likely a biretta, associated with clergy, and a fur-lined cloak or robe. There are no visible accessories. The background features a crosshatched pattern, with Latin text and decorative embellishments below the portrait.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Mordecai
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed close to plate mark): 17.2 x 21.3 cm (6 3/4 x 8 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a ceremonial figure on horseback surrounded by a crowd. The person on the horse is adorned in elaborate attire, accompanied by a throng of people displaying various gestures. The crowd is densely packed, with a variety of expressions and poses. The background includes architectural elements like arches and columns. The detailed line work and shading create depth and texture in the image.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child in the Clouds
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman holding a child, both visible from the waist up. The woman is shown in a sitting position, cradling the child in her arms. Her face is softly sketched with a gentle expression. She is wearing flowing robes with intricate details, and her hair is mostly covered by a draped hood. The child is wrapped in a swaddling cloth and is close to the woman. The background is composed of hatched lines radiating outwards with faint outlines resembling clouds or abstract shapes.

artworks.title: Old Man Shading His Eyes with His Hand
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body and head of a person in a seated position, with their head tilted back and covered by their arm. The person appears to have long hair or a hat that blends with the fur-like texture drawn on their shoulder. They are wearing a garment with a textured detail around the shoulder area. The person's hand is resting on their head, and the lines highlight the furrowed detail of the hand. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the central figure with minimal distractions.

artworks.title: God the Father and Angels Adoring the Madonna and Child [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on buff oatmeal paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Kate Ganz in memory of Victor and Sally Ganz
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring multiple figures in a dramatic composition. The figures are arranged in a monochromatic palette of browns and grays. One figure in flowing robes is seated in the lower left against swirling clouds or smoke. Another figure with wings is depicted in the upper right, suggesting movement through the air. The artwork has an expressive quality with flowing lines and a sense of movement and emotion conveyed by the figures and environment. The style and execution indicate the artist is skilled in capturing dynamic scenes with drama and movement.

artworks.title: Sketch for the Flight into Egypt [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Kate Ganz in memory of Victor and Sally Ganz
artworks.description: The image shows faint, swirling lines and curves across a lightly stained background. The shapes suggest movement of ribbons or loose threads, creating a sense of fluidity. The lines intermingle in a random fashion, resembling delicate tendrils or winding paths. The overall effect conveys subtlety and the interaction of ethereal forms on the paper.

artworks.title: Bathers
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Werner H. and Sarah-Ann Kramarsky
artworks.description: This painting depicts a group of nude figures bathing near a tree-lined body of water. The figures are depicted in a soft, flowing style with a pale color palette, creating a serene atmosphere. The background shows an abstracted landscape with hills and foliage rendered through loose brushwork. The style is reminiscent of Paul Cézanne, focusing on form and subtle use of color and light to convey depth and volume.

artworks.title: Gondolas
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of Lore Heinemann in memory of her husband, Dr. Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The image shows several small boats on a body of water stretching across the middle of the scene. The horizon is not distinctly marked. The artwork is rendered in a loose and fluid style with quick, expressive brushstrokes capturing the boat forms and passengers. The color palette is monochromatic with earthy browns against a pale background. Figures are depicted working their oars, with a sketchy style conveying motion and activity. Additional boats with figures are seen beyond them, creating a sense of depth and spatial configuration.

artworks.title: Ignis
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over red chalk with gray and brown wash and white heightening on pink tinted paper, with pin pricks throughout the figure
artworks.description: The image shows a nude male figure standing in a dynamic pose. The man has his left arm extended upwards, holding a stick or scepter, and his right hand holding a spherical object emitting light. His head is turned slightly to his right, and his hair is windblown. The figure has defined facial features with a strong jawline, a straight nose, and high cheekbones. Over his shoulders, there is a flowing piece of cloth that billows behind him. In the background, there is a lion beside the man, a swirl of smoke or mist at his feet, and a faint line of human figures in the distance. The setting is in shades of brown ink and wash, creating an antique feel.

artworks.title: Allegorical Figure with a Cat and a Pig
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Borghi in honor of Angelo and Marie Guarino
artworks.description: The image is an ink drawing of a person standing in a relaxed posture. The figure faces forward with one arm resting on the side and the other raised, lightly touching their head. The face has classical proportions, with a straight nose and full lips, and the hair is depicted in curls. The body is mostly uncovered, with only hints of draped clothing around the shoulders. The person holds a cluster of foliage or a garland in one hand. The background includes architectural elements like a pillar and archway, with the area around the figure outlined with hatching for shadow and depth.

artworks.title: Giovanni Battista Piranesi
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper mounted on album page
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in profile, facing left. He has one hand on his hip and the other holding a rolled object. The man has defined facial features, a prominent nose, and a proud expression. He has a receding hairline with longer hair tied back. He wears a coat with wide sleeves, a waistcoat, knee breeches, stockings, and shoes with buckles. There is text at the bottom identifying him as "Sig. Gio. Battà Piranesi Architetto, ed Incis. in Roma."

artworks.title: Study of Flesh Color and Gold
artworks.medium: pastel on paper coated with mauve-gray grit (on strainer)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Raymond J. and Margaret Horowitz
artworks.description: Shown from the hips up, a mostly nude woman with pale skin and dark hair pulled up into a loose bun sits with her back to us in this vertical pastel. Touches of sunshine yellow, scarlet red, and black suggest a pattern on the spring green cloth loosely encircling her hips along the bottom edge of the paper. She seems to hold her hands in front of her body so her elbows are bent and she looks down, perhaps at something in her lap. Her black hair is flecked with white to suggest glinting light. The background is filled with a golden yellow field interspersed with hazy turquoise, tomato red, sky blue, and black shapes. It is loosely rendered with pastel to create a blurry effect. Eventually it becomes evident that it is a Japanese screen with clusters of people, landscape, and perhaps a courtyard. The artist signed the work with red letters near the woman’s right hip: “Wm M Chase.”

artworks.title: A Priest Processing through a Medieval Street in Viterbo
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a perspective view of a street scene. The observer appears to be looking down slightly onto the street, which recedes into the distance. The tall buildings align along the street form the vertical limits of the scene. The brushstrokes or drawing lines are detailed and fine, creating intricate textures, especially noticeable in the rendering of brickwork and architectural details. The color palette is primarily monochromatic with sepia tones. Close to us are a group of people gathered, dressed in long robes, with a cobblestone street spreading out in front of them. Beyond, the street leads into arches that frame views further back, where more figures and structural elements can be seen. In the background, the arches and buildings recede, with one large tower-like structure prominently placed on the right side of the image.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, seated with his head resting on his right hand. He has short, curly hair and is dressed in a loose-fitting coat and shirt with a high collar. The man has a determined expression with intense eyes, a prominent forehead, and is gazing directly at the viewer. There are no visible objects or jewelry in the image. The background is dark and plain.

artworks.title: Captain Graham and Captain MacLeod, 42nd Regiment
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.description: The image shows three men. Two men are in the foreground, while one is in the background. The men in the foreground are standing in front of a large white tent and another structure is visible in the background. The man on the left is leaning on a walking stick, has a beard and mustache, and is wearing a dark coat over a long tunic. He also wears a hat. The man on the right stands with his legs apart, has a mustache and beard, and is wearing a heavy coat with fur trim. He holds a cane. The third man, in the background on the left, is also wearing a dark suit and cap. The ground is rough with rocks and there are additional tents in the blurred background.

artworks.title: Teresa Scala, Calabrese
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a woman's upper body. She is facing slightly to the right in a three-quarter profile. She has smooth skin, large eyes, and a serene expression. Her hair is styled in soft waves and gathered in a braided hair net. She wears a garment with a V-shaped neckline and round earrings. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Venus and Cupid
artworks.medium: woodcut printed in red on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 28.7 x 19.8 cm (11 5/16 x 7 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a classical contrapposto position. She looks down at a small winged child beside her, often identified as a cherub or Cupid, who holds a bow and arrow. The woman's hair is styled in an intricate updo with vine-like elements, and she wears a necklace. She holds a piece of draped fabric or cloth in one hand. Around her, there is a tree with hanging coats of arms and branches reaching up. In the background, there is a hilly landscape with architectural structures like buildings or ruins, and clusters of clouds in the sky. The scene is primarily in red ink on a light-colored background, highlighting the intricate linework defining the forms.

artworks.title: View of Castle Sachsenburg
artworks.medium: etching in brown on wove paper, hand-colored with brown wash [proof]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 30.2 x 43.2 cm (11 7/8 x 17 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a wide view. A structure resembling a castle is visible on a rocky hill in the distance surrounded by trees. The painting features delicate brushstrokes depicting foliage, architecture, and a river with a family and an animal. The color palette is dominated by sepia tones, giving the scene an antique feel. Houses can be seen in the distance amidst trees and hills.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Paris
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Eugene Victor Thaw
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in a mythological scene. The central figure wears armor and a helmet, holding a spear, surrounded by other figures. There are trees in the background. One figure is seated, and a winged figure is in the upper right corner. The drawing is in dark tones, with a dramatic and ancient style.

artworks.title: Mountain of the Holy Cross
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Avalon Fund, Florian Carr Fund, Barbara and Jack Kay Fund, Gift of Max and Heidi Berry and Veverka Family Foundation Fund
artworks.description: We look across a bank of large boulders that give way to a waterfall in the middle distance, behind which a towering mountain marked with a white cross rises near the top of this vertical watercolor landscape. Painted with swirling washes of topaz and powder blue, cream white, and some touches of pale golden yellow, the central mountain ascends amid the clouds that settle around the peaks to either side. Slivers of white along the central and neighboring mountains echo the white cross, which seems to have been made with fallen snow on the face of the central peak. Clouds or fog eddying around the neighboring peaks make the middle distance hazy. Closer to us, some scrubby pine-green trees line a riverbank that feeds a waterfall in the lower third of the composition. The water falls behind the slate-gray boulders hulking in the lower left corner of the paper. A bird flies in the mist near the falls.

artworks.title: Hunters Leaving a Forest
artworks.medium: etching on beige wove paper (proof)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a tree trunk on the left side, branches covered in foliage. Near the tree, two deer stand in the underbrush, one a doe and the other a fawn. In the distance under tree canopies, small figures are visible. The painting is detailed, with precise brushstrokes emphasizing textures. The color scheme is sepia, enhancing a tranquil atmosphere. A waterway reflects greenery, leading the eye to the background where the landscape fades into the horizon.

artworks.title: Saint George and the Dragon
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a knight on horseback slaying a dragon. The knight is clad in plate armor with a plumed helmet and is spearing the dragon with a long lance. The horse rears beneath the knight. The dragon has scales and a serpentine tail and is shown in a posture of forced submission beneath the horse. Stylized trees and rocky formations are in the background. The artwork is composed with fine lines and cross-hatching to delineate form and texture.

artworks.title: Panorama of the Danube near Grinzing
artworks.medium: brush and gray ink over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with distant hills, a plateau, and a winding river. Structures including a church steeple and a castle-like building are visible. A person on horseback is leading sheep on a path. The artwork is done in monochromatic gray tones with subtle brushstrokes, creating a serene appearance. The color palette consists of light grays and whites, suggesting a misty atmosphere.
